evidence: Has the Descriptors label, heavily alters src/script/descriptor.cpp, and updates wallet storage and scriptpubkeyman handling for multipath descriptors.
rationale: Preserves multipath descriptor strings instead of prematurely expanding and discarding them during parsing. As stated in the description, 'Once we finish parsing such a string, the multipath elements are lost... This means that we are unable to return the multipath string for such descriptors'; representing them in a single object resolves this limitation and unblocks follow-on work like #36443.
